learning_objective: 🎯 Understand the profound impact of words, communication, and the people who deliver our messages, bridging the gap between hearts!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A carrier of words (like a postman or a messenger) does not just deliver paper; they deliver joy, sorrow, news, and deep human emotions. They are the physical link between two distant people.
Words have immense power. A few written lines can bring a smile to a grieving face or bring tears of joy. The carrier bears the 'weight' of these powerful emotions in their bag.
Before the era of instant messaging, waiting for a letter was a beautiful, suspenseful experience. The arrival of the carrier was a significant event in daily life.
Despite physical distances, words keep relationships alive. The chapter highlights how communication builds and sustains the invisible threads that connect human hearts.

fun_activity.title: ✉️ Write a Real Letter
fun_activity.instructions: In this digital age, handwritten letters are rare. Write a short, heartfelt letter to a friend or grandparent, put it in an envelope, and post it. Become a carrier of words yourself!

exam_tips: 📌 Describe the emotions associated with receiving a letter (joy, anxiety, relief).
📌 Explain the metaphor 'Carrier of Words'—it signifies carrying feelings, not just physical ink and paper.
📌 Contrast the old postal system with modern digital communication in terms of emotional value.
quick_recap: ⭐ The carrier bridges the geographical gap between sender and receiver.
⭐ Words carry the power to heal, connect, and transform.
⭐ Patience and anticipation make the received message even more valuable.
